ServerScriptService.Services.DiplomacySe:
--!strict

--[[
	Diplomacy V0.1.

	Server-authoritative Alliance and NAP between independent root rulers.
	Consumes Political Hierarchy; does not duplicate the tree.
	No warfare, map, or title effects.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.DiplomacyConfig)
local Hierarchy = require(ServerScriptService.Services.PoliticalHierarchyService)

local DiplomacyService = {}

type Agreement = {
	leftId: string,
	rightId: string,
	alliance: boolean,
	nap: boolean,
	allianceInstanceId: string?,
}

type DipRequest = {
	requestId: string,
	agreementType: string,
	fromRulerId: string,
	toRulerId: string,
	createdAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	expireThread: thread?,
}

local started = false
local agreementsByKey: { [string]: Agreement } = {}
local requestsById: { [string]: DipRequest } = {}
local clientIntent: RemoteEvent
local serverPush: RemoteEvent
local debugSnapshot: StringValue?

local function now(): number
	return os.clock()
end

local function pairKey(a: string, b: string): string
	if a < b then
		return a .. "|" .. b
	end
	return b .. "|" .. a
end

local function orderedPair(a: string, b: string): (string, string)
	if a < b then
		return a, b
	end
	return b, a
end

local function lifetime(): number
	local value = Config.RequestLifetimeSeconds
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value <= 0 then
		return 30
	end
	return value
end

local function findRuler(rulerId: string): any?
	for _, ruler in Hierarchy.GetSnapshot().rulers do
		if ruler.rulerId == rulerId then
			return ruler
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function isIndependentRoot(ruler: any?): boolean
	return ruler ~= nil and ruler.independent == true
end

local function noticePlayer(player: Player, message: string)
	print("[Diplomacy] notice ->", player.Name, message)
	serverPush:FireClient(player, "Notice", message)
end

local function noticeRulerId(rulerId: string, message: string)
	local ruler = findRuler(rulerId)
	local userId = ruler and tonumber(ruler.userId)
	if typeof(userId) == "number" and userId ~= 0 then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if player then
			noticePlayer(player, message)
		end
	end
end

local function cancelExpire(request: DipRequest)
	local thread = request.expireThread
	request.expireThread = nil
	if thread then
		pcall(function()
			task.cancel(thread)
		end)
	end
end

local function removeRequest(requestId: string)
	local request = requestsById[requestId]
	if not request then
		return
	end
	cancelExpire(request)
	requestsById[requestId] = nil
end

local function getOrCreateAgreement(a: string, b: string): Agreement
	local key = pairKey(a, b)
	local existing = agreementsByKey[key]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local left, right = orderedPair(a, b)
	local created: Agreement = {
		leftId = left,
		rightId = right,
		alliance = false,
		nap = false,
	}
	agreementsByKey[key] = created
	return created
end

local function pruneEmpty(agreement: Agreement)
	if not agreement.alliance and not agreement.nap then
		agreementsByKey[pairKey(agreement.leftId, agreement.rightId)] = nil
	end
end

local function findPendingSameType(a: string, b: string, agreementType: string): DipRequest?
	local t = now()
	for _, request in requestsById do
		if request.agreementType == agreementType and request.expiresAt > t then
			local same = pairKey(request.fromRulerId, request.toRulerId) == pairKey(a, b)
			if same then
				return request
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildSnapshot()
	local agreements = {}
	for _, agreement in agreementsByKey do
		if agreement.alliance or agreement.nap then
			table.insert(agreements, {
				leftRulerId = agreement.leftId,
				rightRulerId = agreement.rightId,
				alliance = agreement.alliance,
				nap = agreement.nap,
				allianceInstanceId = agreement.allianceInstanceId or "",
			})
		end
	end
	table.sort(agreements, function(x, y)
		if x.leftRulerId ~= y.leftRulerId then
			return x.leftRulerId < y.leftRulerId
		end
		return x.rightRulerId < y.rightRulerId
	end)
	local requests = {}
	local t = now()
	for _, request in requestsById do
		if request.expiresAt > t then
			table.insert(requests, {
				requestId = request.requestId,
				agreementType = request.agreementType,
				fromRulerId = request.fromRulerId,
				toRulerId = request.toRulerId,
				expiresAt = request.expiresAt,
			})
		end
	end
	return {
		agreements = agreements,
		requests = requests,
	}
end

local function pushState(toPlayer: Player?)
	local payload = buildSnapshot()
	local encoded = HttpService:JSONEncode(payload)
	if debugSnapshot then
		debugSnapshot.Value = encoded
	end
	if toPlayer then
		print("[Diplomacy] push State to", toPlayer.Name)
		serverPush:FireClient(toPlayer, "State", encoded)
	else
		print("[Diplomacy] push State all clients agreements=", #payload.agreements, "requests=", #payload.requests)
		serverPush:FireAllClients("State", encoded)
	end
end

local function typeLabel(agreementType: string): string
	if agreementType == "NAP" then
		return "Non-Aggression Pact"
	end
	return "Alliance"
end

function DiplomacyService.GetSnapshot()
	return buildSnapshot()
end

function DiplomacyService.AreAllied(rulerA: string, rulerB: string): boolean
	local a = findRuler(rulerA)
	local b = findRuler(rulerB)
	if not a or not b then
		return false
	end
	local ra = a.rootRulerId
	local rb = b.rootRulerId
	if ra == rb then
		return false
	end
	local agreement = agreementsByKey[pairKey(ra, rb)]
	return agreement ~= nil and agreement.alliance == true
end

function DiplomacyService.HasNonAggressionPact(rulerA: string, rulerB: string): boolean
	local a = findRuler(rulerA)
	local b = findRuler(rulerB)
	if not a or not b then
		return false
	end
	local ra = a.rootRulerId
	local rb = b.rootRulerId
	if ra == rb then
		return false
	end
	local agreement = agreementsByKey[pairKey(ra, rb)]
	return agreement ~= nil and agreement.nap == true
end

local function dissolveInvolving(rulerId: string, reason: string)
	local removedAny = false
	for key, agreement in agreementsByKey do
		if agreement.leftId == rulerId or agreement.rightId == rulerId then
			local other = if agreement.leftId == rulerId then agreement.rightId else agreement.leftId
			if agreement.alliance then
				noticeRulerId(other, "Alliance dissolved (" .. reason .. ").")
			end
			if agreement.nap then
				noticeRulerId(other, "Non-Aggression Pact dissolved (" .. reason .. ").")
			end
			agreementsByKey[key] = nil
			removedAny = true
		end
	end
	local t = now()
	for requestId, request in requestsById do
		if request.fromRulerId == rulerId or request.toRulerId == rulerId then
			if request.expiresAt > t then
				local other = if request.fromRulerId == rulerId then request.toRulerId else request.fromRulerId
				noticeRulerId(other, typeLabel(request.agreementType) .. " offer is no longer valid.")
			end
			removeRequest(requestId)
			removedAny = true
		end
	end
	if removedAny then
		noticeRulerId(rulerId, "External diplomatic agreements ended (" .. reason .. ").")
		pushState()
	end
end

function DiplomacyService.Offer(fromRulerId: string, toRulerId: string, agreementType: string): (boolean, string)
	if agreementType ~= "Alliance" and agreementType ~= "NAP" then
		return false, "Unknown agreement type."
	end
	if fromRulerId == toRulerId then
		return false, "Cannot conduct diplomacy with yourself."
	end
	local fromRuler = findRuler(fromRulerId)
	local toRuler = findRuler(toRulerId)
	if not isIndependentRoot(fromRuler) or not isIndependentRoot(toRuler) then
		return false, "Only independent rulers may conduct this diplomacy."
	end
	local agreement = agreementsByKey[pairKey(fromRulerId, toRulerId)]
	if agreementType == "Alliance" and agreement and agreement.alliance then
		return false, "Alliance already exists."
	end
	if agreementType == "NAP" and agreement and agreement.nap then
		return false, "Non-Aggression Pact already exists."
	end
	if findPendingSameType(fromRulerId, toRulerId, agreementType) then
		return false, "A matching offer is already pending."
	end
	local requestId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local created = now()
	local ttl = lifetime()
	local request: DipRequest = {
		requestId = requestId,
		agreementType = agreementType,
		fromRulerId = fromRulerId,
		toRulerId = toRulerId,
		createdAt = created,
		expiresAt = created + ttl,
		expireThread = nil,
	}
	request.expireThread = task.delay(ttl, function()
		local expired = requestsById[requestId]
		if expired then
			expired.expireThread = nil
			removeRequest(requestId)
			pushState()
			noticeRulerId(expired.fromRulerId, typeLabel(expired.agreementType) .. " offer expired.")
			noticeRulerId(expired.toRulerId, typeLabel(expired.agreementType) .. " offer expired.")
		end
	end)
	requestsById[requestId] = request
	pushState()
	noticeRulerId(toRulerId, typeLabel(agreementType) .. " offered.")
	return true, requestId
end

function DiplomacyService.Decline(requestId: string, actorRulerId: string): (boolean, string)
	local request = requestsById[requestId]
	if not request then
		return false, "Request is no longer valid."
	end
	if now() >= request.expiresAt then
		removeRequest(requestId)
		pushState()
		return false, "Request has expired."
	end
	if actorRulerId ~= request.toRulerId then
		return false, "Only the recipient may decline this offer."
	end
	local fromId = request.fromRulerId
	local toId = request.toRulerId
	local label = typeLabel(request.agreementType)
	removeRequest(requestId)
	pushState()
	noticeRulerId(toId, label .. " declined.")
	noticeRulerId(fromId, label .. " declined.")
	return true, label .. " declined."
end

function DiplomacyService.Accept(requestId: string, actorRulerId: string): (boolean, string)
	local request = requestsById[requestId]
	if not request then
		return false, "Request is no longer valid."
	end
	if now() >= request.expiresAt then
		removeRequest(requestId)
		pushState()
		return false, "Request has expired."
	end
	if actorRulerId ~= request.toRulerId then
		return false, "Only the recipient may accept this offer."
	end
	local fromRuler = findRuler(request.fromRulerId)
	local toRuler = findRuler(request.toRulerId)
	if not isIndependentRoot(fromRuler) or not isIndependentRoot(toRuler) then
		removeRequest(requestId)
		pushState()
		return false, "Only independent rulers may conduct this diplomacy."
	end
	local agreement = getOrCreateAgreement(request.fromRulerId, request.toRulerId)
	if request.agreementType == "Alliance" then
		if agreement.alliance then
			removeRequest(requestId)
			pushState()
			return false, "Alliance already exists."
		end
		agreement.alliance = true
		agreement.allianceInstanceId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	else
		if agreement.nap then
			removeRequest(requestId)
			pushState()
			return false, "Non-Aggression Pact already exists."
		end
		agreement.nap = true
	end
	local label = typeLabel(request.agreementType)
	removeRequest(requestId)
	pushState()
	noticeRulerId(request.toRulerId, label .. " accepted.")
	noticeRulerId(request.fromRulerId, label .. " accepted.")
	return true, label .. " accepted."
end

function DiplomacyService.Break(fromRulerId: string, toRulerId: string, agreementType: string): (boolean, string)
	if agreementType ~= "Alliance" and agreementType ~= "NAP" then
		return false, "Unknown agreement type."
	end
	local fromRuler = findRuler(fromRulerId)
	if not isIndependentRoot(fromRuler) then
		return false, "Only independent rulers may break this agreement."
	end
	local agreement = agreementsByKey[pairKey(fromRulerId, toRulerId)]
	if not agreement then
		return false, "No such agreement."
	end
	if agreementType == "Alliance" then
		if not agreement.alliance then
			return false, "No Alliance with that realm."
		end
		agreement.alliance = false
		agreement.allianceInstanceId = nil
	else
		if not agreement.nap then
			return false, "No Non-Aggression Pact with that realm."
		end
		agreement.nap = false
	end
	pruneEmpty(agreement)
	pushState()
	local label = typeLabel(agreementType)
	noticeRulerId(fromRulerId, label .. " broken.")
	noticeRulerId(toRulerId, label .. " broken.")
	return true, label .. " broken."
end

local function onClientIntent(player: Player, action: any, a: any, b: any)
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then
		noticePlayer(player, "Invalid request.")
		return
	end
	if action == "Ready" then
		print("[Diplomacy] Ready from", player.Name)
		pushState(player)
		return
	end
	local fromId = Hierarchy.GetRulerIdForUserId(player.UserId)
	if not fromId then
		noticePlayer(player, "No ruler record.")
		return
	end
	if action == "OfferAlliance" or action == "OfferNAP" then
		if typeof(a) ~= "string" then
			noticePlayer(player, "Invalid target.")
			return
		end
		local kind = if action == "OfferAlliance" then "Alliance" else "NAP"
		local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Offer(fromId, a, kind)
		if not ok then
			noticePlayer(player, result)
		else
			noticePlayer(player, typeLabel(kind) .. " offered.")
		end
		return
	end
	if action == "Accept" or action == "Decline" then
		if typeof(a) ~= "string" then
			noticePlayer(player, "Invalid request.")
			return
		end
		local ok, result
		if action == "Accept" then
			ok, result = DiplomacyService.Accept(a, fromId)
		else
			ok, result = DiplomacyService.Decline(a, fromId)
		end
		if not ok then
			noticePlayer(player, result)
		end
		return
	end
	if action == "BreakAlliance" or action == "BreakNAP" then
		if typeof(a) ~= "string" then
			noticePlayer(player, "Invalid target.")
			return
		end
		local kind = if action == "BreakAlliance" then "Alliance" else "NAP"
		local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Break(fromId, a, kind)
		if not ok then
			noticePlayer(player, result)
		end
		return
	end
	noticePlayer(player, "Unknown action.")
end

local function syncIndependence()
	for _, ruler in Hierarchy.GetSnapshot().rulers do
		if ruler.independent ~= true then
			dissolveInvolving(ruler.rulerId, "no longer independent")
		end
	end
end

function DiplomacyService.Start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true

	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes") :: Folder
	clientIntent = remotesFolder:WaitForChild("DiplomacyClientEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	serverPush = remotesFolder:WaitForChild("DiplomacyServerEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	clientIntent.OnServerEvent:Connect(onClientIntent)

	local debugFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("DiplomacyDebug")
	if debugFolder then
		debugFolder:Destroy()
	end
	debugFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	debugFolder.Name = "DiplomacyDebug"
	debugFolder.Parent = ServerScriptService
	debugSnapshot = Instance.new("StringValue")
	debugSnapshot.Name = "LastSnapshot"
	debugSnapshot.Parent = debugFolder
	local help = Instance.new("StringValue")
	help.Name = "Help"
	help.Value =
		"Prototype only. Invoke Offer/Accept/Decline/Break; or DipOffer=fromId=toId=Alliance|NAP; Accept=requestId=actorId; Break=fromId=toId=Alliance|NAP"
	help.Parent = debugFolder
	local invoke = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	invoke.Name = "Invoke"
	invoke.Parent = debugFolder
	invoke.OnInvoke = function(action: any, a: any, b: any, c: any)
		if action == "Offer" then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Offer(a, b, c)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Invoke Offer", ok, result)
			return ok, result
		elseif action == "Accept" then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Accept(a, b)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Invoke Accept", ok, result)
			return ok, result
		elseif action == "Decline" then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Decline(a, b)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Invoke Decline", ok, result)
			return ok, result
		elseif action == "Break" then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Break(a, b, c)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Invoke Break", ok, result)
			return ok, result
		end
		return false, "Unknown debug action."
	end

	debugFolder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DipOffer"):Connect(function()
		local raw = debugFolder:GetAttribute("DipOffer")
		if typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local fromId, toId, kind = string.match(raw, "^(.-)=(.-)=(Alliance|NAP)$")
		if fromId and toId and kind then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Offer(fromId, toId, kind)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Offer", ok, result)
		end
	end)
	debugFolder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Accept"):Connect(function()
		local raw = debugFolder:GetAttribute("Accept")
		if typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local requestId, actorId = string.match(raw, "^(.-)=(.+)$")
		if requestId and actorId then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Accept(requestId, actorId)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Accept", ok, result)
		end
	end)
	debugFolder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Break"):Connect(function()
		local raw = debugFolder:GetAttribute("Break")
		if typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local fromId, toId, kind = string.match(raw, "^(.-)=(.-)=(Alliance|NAP)$")
		if fromId and toId and kind then
			local ok, result = DiplomacyService.Break(fromId, toId, kind)
			print("[Diplomacy] debug Break", ok, result)
		end
	end)

	_G.__DiplomacyV01 = DiplomacyService

	Hierarchy.StateChanged:Connect(syncIndependence)
	Hierarchy.RulerRemoving:Connect(function(rulerId: string)
		dissolveInvolving(rulerId, "left the match")
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.defer(function()
			if player.Parent then
				pushState(player)
			end
		end)
	end)

	pushState()
	print("[Diplomacy] service started")
end

return DiplomacyService
ServerScriptService.Services.AdminBridge:
--!strict

--[[
	Project Admin Bridge V0.1.

	Kohl's Admin (and Studio debug) call this module. Gameplay services do not
	require Kohl. All mutations go through existing authoritative APIs.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AdminConfig = require(script.Parent.AdminConfig)
local Hierarchy = require(script.Parent.PoliticalHierarchyService)
local Territory = require(script.Parent.TerritoryMapService)
local Title = require(script.Parent.TitleProgressionService)
local Warfare = require(script.Parent.WarfareService)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)
local Military = require(script.Parent.MilitaryService)
local Communications = require(script.Parent.CommunicationsService)

local AdminBridge = {}

export type ExecuteResult = {
	ok: boolean,
	message: string,
}

local function fail(message: string): (boolean, string)
	return false, message
end

function AdminBridge.IsGameTester(userId: number): boolean
	return AdminConfig.IsGameTester(userId)
end

function AdminBridge.HelpText(): string
	return table.concat({
		"GameTester commands (UserId allowlist; Kohl rank is not enough).",
		"Studio Local Server only: synthetic UserIds < 0 are allowed for testing.",
		";adminhelp",
		";inspectwars",
		";inspectterritory <territoryId>",
		";inspectruler <player|rulerId>",
		";setowner <territoryId> <player|rulerId|unclaimed>",
		";setprestige <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";inspectgold <player|rulerId>",
		";setgold <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";addgold <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";spendgold <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";inspecttroops <player|rulerId>",
		";settroops <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";addtroops <player|rulerId> <number>",
		";inspectmilitary <warId>",
		";inspectcontest",
		";resolvewar <warId> attacker|defender",
		";inspectcomms",
		";announce <text>",
		"Studio fallback: ServerScriptService.AdminDebug.Invoke",
	}, "\n")
end

local function rulerLabel(rulerId: string): string
	for _, ruler in Hierarchy.GetSnapshot().rulers do
		if ruler.rulerId == rulerId then
			return string.format("%s (%s)", ruler.displayName, rulerId)
		end
	end
	return rulerId
end

local function firstPlayer(value: any): Player?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		return value
	end
	if typeof(value) == "table" then
		local first = (value :: any)[1]
		if typeof(first) == "Instance" and first:IsA("Player") then
			return first
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function AdminBridge.ResolveRulerId(ref: any): (string?, string?)
	if ref == nil then
		return nil, "Need a player, rulerId, or unclaimed."
	end
	local player = firstPlayer(ref)
	if player then
		local mapped = Hierarchy.GetRulerIdForUserId(player.UserId)
		if mapped then
			return mapped, nil
		end
		return nil, "No ruler for player " .. player.Name
	end
	if typeof(ref) ~= "string" then
		ref = tostring(ref)
	end
	local s = ref :: string
	if s == "" then
		return nil, "Need a player, rulerId, or unclaimed."
	end
	local snap = Hierarchy.GetSnapshot()
	for _, ruler in snap.rulers do
		if ruler.rulerId == s then
			return s, nil
		end
	end
	local asUser = tonumber(s)
	if asUser then
		local mapped = Hierarchy.GetRulerIdForUserId(asUser)
		if mapped then
			return mapped, nil
		end
	end
	local lower = string.lower(s)
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(p.Name) == lower or string.lower(p.DisplayName) == lower then
			local mapped = Hierarchy.GetRulerIdForUserId(p.UserId)
			if mapped then
				return mapped, nil
			end
			return nil, "No ruler for player " .. p.Name
		end
	end
	for _, ruler in snap.rulers do
		if typeof(ruler.displayName) == "string" and string.lower(ruler.displayName) == lower then
			return ruler.rulerId, nil
		end
	end
	return nil, "Could not resolve ruler: " .. s
end

local function inspectWars(): (boolean, string)
	local snap = Warfare.GetSnapshot()
	local wars = snap.wars or {}
	local cooldowns = snap.cooldowns or {}
	local lines = { string.format("Active wars: %d", #wars) }
	for _, war in wars do
		table.insert(
			lines,
			string.format(
				"%s\n attacker: %s\n defender: %s\n target: %s",
				tostring(war.warId),
				rulerLabel(war.attackerRootId),
				rulerLabel(war.defenderRootId),
				tostring(war.targetTerritoryId)
			)
		)
	end
	if #cooldowns > 0 then
		table.insert(lines, string.format("Post-war cooldowns: %d", #cooldowns))
		for _, row in cooldowns do
			table.insert(lines, string.format(" %s until %s", tostring(row.territoryId), tostring(row.endsAt)))
		end
	end
	if #wars == 0 and #cooldowns == 0 then
		return true, "No active wars."
	end
	return true, table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function inspectTerritory(territoryId: string): (boolean, string)
	if typeof(territoryId) ~= "string" or territoryId == "" then
		return fail("Need territoryId.")
	end
	territoryId = string.lower(territoryId)

	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local event = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminFeedbackEvent")
	if not (event and event:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
		return
	end
	local payload = {
		ok = ok,
		operation = operation,
		message = message,
	}
	if actorUserId ~= nil then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(actorUserId)
		if player then
			event:FireClient(player, payload)
		end
		return
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if AdminConfig.IsGameTester(player.UserId) then
			event:FireClient(player, payload)
		end
	end
end

function AdminBridge.Execute(actorUserId: number?, operation: string, a: any, b: any, c: any): (boolean, string)
	local function done(ok: boolean, message: string): (boolean, string)
		pushFeedback(actorUserId, if typeof(operation) == "string" then operation else "Unknown", ok, message)
		return ok, message
	end
	if actorUserId ~= nil then
		if not AdminConfig.IsGameTester(actorUserId) then
			print("[Admin] denied userId", actorUserId, operation)
			return done(fail("Not a GameTester."))
		end
	end
	if typeof(operation) ~= "string" then
		return done(fail("Need operation."))
	end
	local op = operation
	print("[Admin] Execute", actorUserId or "studio", op, a, b, c)
	if op == "Help" then
		return done(true, AdminBridge.HelpText())
	elseif op == "InspectWars" then
		return done(inspectWars())
	elseif op == "InspectTerritory" then
		return done(inspectTerritory(a))
	elseif op == "InspectRuler" then
		return done(inspectRuler(a))
	elseif op == "SetOwner" then
		return done(setOwner(a, b))
	elseif op == "SetPrestige" then
		return done(setPrestige(a, b))
	elseif op == "InspectGold" then
		return done(inspectGold(a))
	elseif op == "SetGold" then
		return done(setGold(a, b))
	elseif op == "AddGold" then
		return done(addGold(a, b))
	elseif op == "SpendGold" then
		return done(spendGold(a, b))
	elseif op == "InspectTroops" then
		return done(inspectTroops(a))
	elseif op == "SetTroops" then
		return done(setTroops(a, b))
	elseif op == "AddTroops" then
		return done(addTroops(a, b))
	elseif op == "InspectMilitary" then
		return done(inspectMilitary(a))
	elseif op == "InspectContest" then
		return done(inspectContest())
	elseif op == "ResolveWar" then
		return done(resolveWar(a, b))
	elseif op == "InspectComms" then
		return done(inspectComms())
	elseif op == "Announce" then
		return done(announce(a))
	end
	local _ = c
	return done(fail("Unknown operation."))
end

return AdminBridge
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.RealmGraph:
--!strict

--[[
	Greater-realm adjacency graph. Uses Territory adjacency + Hierarchy roots.
	Not visual proximity. Server must recompute from live ownership.
]]

local RealmGraph = {}

local function rootOf(ruler: any): string?
	if typeof(ruler) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	if typeof(ruler.rootRulerId) == "string" and ruler.rootRulerId ~= "" then
		return ruler.rootRulerId
	end
	if typeof(ruler.rulerId) == "string" then
		return ruler.rulerId
	end
	return nil
end

function RealmGraph.LandsByRoot(rulers: { any }, ownedByRuler: (string) -> { string }): { [string]: { string } }
	local lands: { [string]: { string } } = {}
	local seen: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}
	for _, ruler in rulers do
		local rootId = rootOf(ruler)
		local rulerId = ruler.rulerId
		if typeof(rootId) == "string" and typeof(rulerId) == "string" then
			if seen[rootId] == nil then
				seen[rootId] = {}
				lands[rootId] = {}
			end
			for _, territoryId in ownedByRuler(rulerId) do
				if seen[rootId][territoryId] ~= true then
					seen[rootId][territoryId] = true
					table.insert(lands[rootId], territoryId)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return lands
end

function RealmGraph.AreRealmsAdjacent(
	landsA: { string },
	landsB: { string },
	areAdjacent: (string, string) -> boolean
): boolean
	for _, a in landsA do
		for _, b in landsB do
			if areAdjacent(a, b) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function RealmGraph.Distance(
	fromRoot: string,
	toRoot: string,
	neighborSet: { [string]: { string } }
): number?
	if fromRoot == toRoot then
		return 0
	end
	local visited: { [string]: boolean } = { [fromRoot] = true }
	local queue = { { id = fromRoot, d = 0 } }
	local head = 1
	while head <= #queue do
		local cur = queue[head]
		head += 1
		local neighbors = neighborSet[cur.id]
		if neighbors then
			for _, nxt in neighbors do
				if visited[nxt] ~= true then
					if nxt == toRoot then
						return cur.d + 1
					end
					visited[nxt] = true
					table.insert(queue, { id = nxt, d = cur.d + 1 })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function RealmGraph.BuildNeighborSet(
	landsByRoot: { [string]: { string } },
	areAdjacent: (string, string) -> boolean
): { [string]: { string } }
	local roots = {}
	for rootId in landsByRoot do
		table.insert(roots, rootId)
	end
	table.sort(roots)
	local neighborSet: { [string]: { string } } = {}
	for _, id in roots do
		neighborSet[id] = {}
	end
	for i = 1, #roots do
		for j = i + 1, #roots do
			local a = roots[i]
			local b = roots[j]
			if RealmGraph.AreRealmsAdjacent(landsByRoot[a], landsByRoot[b], areAdjacent) then
				table.insert(neighborSet[a], b)
				table.insert(neighborSet[b], a)
			end
		end
	end
	return neighborSet
end

return RealmGraph
ServerScriptService.Services.AdminServic:
--!strict

--[[
	Admin / testing foundation. Starts after gameplay services.

	Exposes ServerScriptService.AdminDebug.Invoke for Studio/MCP.
	If official Kohl's Admin is present, clones AdminKohlAddon into Addons.
	Does not install Kohl's Admin itself.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local AdminBridge = require(script.Parent.AdminBridge)

local AdminService = {}

local started = false
local KOHL_ADDON_TAG = "Kohl's Admin Addon"
local lateRegisterDone = false
local lateRegisterPasses = 0
local LATE_REGISTER_PASSES = 3
local loggedPresence = false
local loggedMissingKohl = false
local loggedMissingAddon = false
local KOHL_NAMES = {
	"Kohl's Admin",
	"Kohls Admin",
	"Kohl's Admin Infinite",
	"KA",
}

local function findAddonsFolder(root: Instance): Folder?
	local addons = root:FindFirstChild("Addons")
	if addons and addons:IsA("Folder") then
		return addons
	end
	local config = root:FindFirstChild("Config")
	if config then
		local nested = config:FindFirstChild("Addons")
		if nested and nested:IsA("Folder") then
			return nested
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function findKohlRoot(): Instance?
	for _, parent in { ServerScriptService, workspace } do
		for _, name in KOHL_NAMES do
			local inst = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
			if inst then
				return inst
			end
		end
		for _, child in parent:GetChildren() do
			if string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "kohl", 1, true) then
				return child
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectAddonsFolders(): { Folder }
	local folders: { Folder } = {}
	local seen = {}
	local function consider(inst: Instance?)
		if inst and inst:IsA("Folder") and not seen[inst] then
			seen[inst] = true
			table.insert(folders, inst)
		end
	end
	local kohl = findKohlRoot()
	if kohl then
		consider(findAddonsFolder(kohl))
	end
	local serverStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local kohlServer = serverStorage:FindFirstChild("Server")
	if kohlServer then
		consider(kohlServer:FindFirstChild("Addons") :: Folder?)
	end
	local rsSource = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Kohl's Admin Source")
	if rsSource then
		consider(rsSource:FindFirstChild("Addons") :: Folder?)
	end
	return folders
end

local function moduleSourceContains(module: ModuleScript, needle: string): boolean
	local ok, source = pcall(function()
		return module.Source
	end)
	return ok and typeof(source) == "string" and string.find(source, needle, 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function shouldReplaceAddon(existing: ModuleScript, sourceName: string): boolean
	if sourceName == "AdminKohlAddon" then
		return moduleSourceContains(existing, "return runOp")
			or moduleSourceContains(existing, "local ok, message = AdminBridge")
			or not moduleSourceContains(existing, "inspectgold")
			or moduleSourceContains(existing, "player # rawString")
			or not moduleSourceContains(existing, "adminOwnerToken")
	end
	if sourceName == "AdminKohlThemeClient" then
		return moduleSourceContains(existing, "changeTheme") and not moduleSourceContains(existing, "Font.fromEnum")
	end
	return false
end

local function replaceAddonWithCanonical(existing: ModuleScript, canonical: ModuleScript): ModuleScript
	local parent = existing.Parent
	local name = existing.Name
	existing:Destroy()
	local clone = canonical:Clone()
	clone.Name = name
	clone:AddTag(KOHL_ADDON_TAG)
	clone.Parent = parent
	return clone
end

local function placeNamedAddon(sourceName: string, tag: boolean): ModuleScript?
	local source = ServerScriptService.Services:FindFirstChild(sourceName)
	if not (source and source:IsA("ModuleScript")) then
		return nil
	end
	local folders = collectAddonsFolders()
	if #folders == 0 then
		return source
	end
	local placed: ModuleScript? = nil
	for _, addons in folders do
		local existing = addons:FindFirstChild(sourceName)
		if existing and existing:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			if existing ~= source and shouldReplaceAddon(existing, sourceName) then
				existing = replaceAddonWithCanonical(existing, source)
				print("[Admin] Replaced stale", sourceName, "at", existing:GetFullName())
			end
			if tag then
				existing:AddTag(KOHL_ADDON_TAG)
			end
			placed = existing
		end
	end
	if placed then
		return placed
	end
	local clone = source:Clone()
	clone.Name = sourceName
	if tag then
		clone:AddTag(KOHL_ADDON_TAG)
	end
	clone.Parent = folders[1]
	print("[Admin] Cloned", sourceName, "into", folders[1]:GetFullName())
	return clone
end

local patchedKohlSettings = false

local function syncKohlConfigTheme()
	if patchedKohlSettings then
		return
	end
	local kohl = findKohlRoot()
	local config = kohl and kohl:FindFirstChild("Config")
	local settings = config and config:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	if settings and settings:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		patchedKohlSettings = true
		pcall(function()
			settings.Source = string.gsub(settings.Source, "getKohlsAdminPopup = true", "getKohlsAdminPopup = false", 1)
		end)
	end
end

local function getCanonicalAddon(): ModuleScript?
	local services = ServerScriptService.Services:FindFirstChild("AdminKohlAddon")
	if services and services:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return services
	end
	for _, folder in collectAddonsFolders() do
		local existing = folder:FindFirstChild("AdminKohlAddon")
		if existing and existing:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			return existing
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function tryLateRegister()
	if lateRegisterDone then
		return
	end
	local interface = shared._K_INTERFACE
	if typeof(interface) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local canonical = ServerScriptService.Services:FindFirstChild("AdminKohlAddon")
	if not (canonical and canonical:IsA("ModuleScript")) then
		return
	end
	-- Kohl loadAddons requires addons in task.spawn after parenting Package to RS.
	-- Wait until that copy exists, then keep re-registering so canonical `run` wins.
	if not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Kohl's Admin Source") then
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local fresh = canonical:Clone()
		fresh.Name = "AdminKohlAddonRegister"
		fresh.Parent = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		local impl = require(fresh) :: any
		impl(interface)
		fresh:Destroy()
	end)
	if ok then
		lateRegisterPasses += 1
		if lateRegisterPasses >= LATE_REGISTER_PASSES then
			lateRegisterDone = true
			print("[Admin] Registered AdminKohlAddon with Kohl _K_INTERFACE.")
		end
	else
		warn("[Admin] Register AdminKohlAddon failed:", err)
	end
end

local function ensureAddonModule(): ModuleScript?
	placeNamedAddon("AdminKohlThemeClient", false)
	syncKohlConfigTheme()
	local source = getCanonicalAddon()
	if not source then
		if not loggedMissingAddon then
			loggedMissingAddon = true
			warn("[Admin] AdminKohlAddon module missing from Services; waiting for Kohl Addons copy.")
		end
		return nil
	end

	local folders = collectAddonsFolders()
	if #folders == 0 then
		return source
	end

	local placed: ModuleScript? = nil
	for _, addons in folders do
		local existing = addons:FindFirstChild("AdminKohlAddon")
		if existing and existing:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			if existing ~= source and shouldReplaceAddon(existing, "AdminKohlAddon") then
				existing = replaceAddonWithCanonical(existing, source)
				print("[Admin] Replaced stale AdminKohlAddon at", existing:GetFullName())
			end
			existing:AddTag(KOHL_ADDON_TAG)
			placed = existing
		end
	end
	if placed then
		if not loggedPresence then
			loggedPresence = true
			print("[Admin] Kohl addon already present under", placed:GetFullName())
		end
		return placed
	end

	local clone = source:Clone()
	clone.Name = "AdminKohlAddon"
	clone:AddTag(KOHL_ADDON_TAG)
	clone.Parent = folders[1]
	print("[Admin] Cloned AdminKohlAddon into", folders[1]:GetFullName())
	return clone
end

local function tryInstallKohlAddon()
	local kohl = findKohlRoot()
	if not kohl then
		if not loggedMissingKohl then
			loggedMissingKohl = true
			print("[Admin] Kohl's Admin not found. Studio AdminDebug.Invoke is available. Director must insert the official Kohl loader (@Scripth) to use chat commands.")
		end
		return
	end
	local module = ensureAddonModule()
	if module then
		tryLateRegister()
	end
end

function AdminService.Start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true

	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if remotesFolder then
		local existing = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("AdminFeedbackEvent")
		if existing and not existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			existing:Destroy()
			existing = nil
		end
		if not existing then
			local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			event.Name = "AdminFeedbackEvent"
			event.Parent = remotesFolder
			print("[Admin] Created AdminFeedbackEvent (server to client only).")
		end
	end

	local debugFolder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("AdminDebug")
	if debugFolder then
		debugFolder:Destroy()
	end
	debugFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	debugFolder.Name = "AdminDebug"
	debugFolder.Parent = ServerScriptService

	local help = Instance.new("StringValue")
	help.Name = "Help"
	help.Value = AdminBridge.HelpText()
	help.Parent = debugFolder

	local invoke = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	invoke.Name = "Invoke"
	invoke.Parent = debugFolder
	invoke.OnInvoke = function(operation: any, a: any, b: any, c: any)
		local ok, result = AdminBridge.Execute(nil, operation, a, b, c)
		print("[Admin] debug Invoke", operation, ok, result)
		return ok, result
	end

	tryInstallKohlAddon()
	ServerScriptService.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(tryInstallKohlAddon)
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 40 do
			tryInstallKohlAddon()
			if lateRegisterDone then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	print("[Admin] AdminBridge started. GameTester UserIds only for live commands.")
end

return AdminService

local function decodeState(payload: any): any?
	if typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(payload)
		end)
		if ok and typeof(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
		return nil
	elseif typeof(payload) == "table" then
		return payload
	end
	return nil
end

local function scaleFromCentroid(polygon: { { x: number, y: number } }, towardCenter: number)
	local cx, cy = MapGeometry.Centroid(polygon)
	local out = {}
	for _, p in polygon do
		table.insert(out, {
			x = p.x + (cx - p.x) * towardCenter,
			y = p.y + (cy - p.y) * towardCenter,
		})
	end
	return out
end

function TerritoryMapController.Start()
	if started or _G.__TerritoryMapV01Started == true then
		return
	end
	started = true
	_G.__TerritoryMapV01Started = true

	local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("HierarchyPrototypeGui", 12)
	if not (gui and gui:IsA("ScreenGui")) then
		warn("[Territory] HierarchyPrototypeGui missing; map idle.")
		started = false
		_G.__TerritoryMapV01Started = nil
		return
	end

	local mapStage = gui:WaitForChild("MapStage") :: Frame
	local viewport = mapStage:FindFirstChild("MapView")
	if not (viewport and viewport:IsA("ViewportFrame")) then
		if viewport then
			viewport:Destroy()
		end
		viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
		viewport.Name = "MapView"
		viewport.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 34, 42)
		viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
		viewport.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		viewport.ZIndex = 1
		viewport.Active = false
		viewport.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
		viewport.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
		viewport.Parent = mapStage
	end
	viewport.Active = false
	local info = gui:WaitForChild("TerritoryInfo") :: Frame
	local infoBody = info:WaitForChild("Body") :: TextLabel
	local selectedValue = info:FindFirstChild("SelectedTerritoryId")

	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	local territoryIntent = remotes:WaitForChild("TerritoryClientEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	local territoryPush = remotes:WaitForChild("TerritoryServerEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	local hierarchyPush = remotes:WaitForChild("HierarchyServerEvent") :: RemoteEvent

	local mapDef = MapCatalog.GetDefault()
	local polygons = {}
	local byId = {}
	for _, t in mapDef.territories do
		byId[t.id] = t
		table.insert(polygons, t.polygon)
	end
	local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = MapGeometry.MapBounds(polygons)
	local spanX = math.max(maxX - minX, 1)
	local spanY = math.max(maxY - minY, 1)
	local midX = (minX + maxX) * 0.5
	local midY = (minY + maxY) * 0.5

	local ownership: { [string]: string } = {}
	local colorIndex: { [string]: number } = {}
	local hierarchyById: { [string]: any } = {}
	local selectedId: string? = nil

	local zoom = 1
	local lookX = midX
	local lookZ = midY
	local dragging = false
	local dragMoved = false
	local dragStart: Vector2? = nil
	local lookStart = Vector2.zero

	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = viewport
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Territories"
	folder.Parent = world
	local fillParts: { [string]: { WedgePart } } = {}
	local rimParts: { [string]: { WedgePart } } = {}
	local selectParts: { [string]: { WedgePart } } = {}

	for _, t in mapDef.territories do
		local selectFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		selectFolder.Name = t.id .. "_select"
		selectFolder.Parent = folder
		local rim = Instance.new("Folder")
		rim.Name = t.id .. "_rim"
		rim.Parent = folder
		local fill = Instance.new("Folder")
		fill.Name = t.id .. "_fill"
		fill.Parent = folder
		-- Gold outline above fill/holder so selection does not replace political colors.
		selectParts[t.id] = MapTriangles.DrawRing(
			selectFolder,
			t.polygon,
			SELECT_COLOR,
			t.id .. "select",
			THICK,
			10,
			THICK * 0.75,
			true
		)
		for _, p in selectParts[t.id] do
			p.Transparency = 1
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			p.Color = SELECT_COLOR
		end
		rimParts[t.id] = MapTriangles.DrawQuad(rim, t.polygon, RealmColors.Unclaimed, t.id .. "rim", THICK, THICK * 0.2)
		fillParts[t.id] = MapTriangles.DrawQuad(
			fill,
			scaleFromCentroid(t.polygon, 0.18),
			RealmColors.Unclaimed,
			t.id .. "fill",
			THICK,
			THICK * 0.55
		)
	end

	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = FOV
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera

	local function rulerOf(rulerId: string?): any?
		if not rulerId or rulerId == "" then
			return nil
		end
		return hierarchyById[rulerId]
	end

	local function ownerColor(ownerId: string): Color3
		local idx = colorIndex[ownerId]
		if typeof(idx) == "number" then
			return RealmColors.ByIndex(idx)
		end
		return RealmColors.ByIndex(1)
	end

	local function cameraHeight(): number
		local size = mapStage.AbsoluteSize
		local aspect = if size.Y > 0 then size.X / size.Y else 1
		local half = math.max(spanX / aspect, spanY) * 0.55 / zoom
		return half / math.tan(math.rad(FOV * 0.5))
	end

	local function applyCamera()
		local h = cameraHeight()
		local size = mapStage.AbsoluteSize
		local aspect = if size.Y > 0 then size.X / size.Y else 1
		local halfZ = h * math.tan(math.rad(FOV * 0.5))
		local halfX = halfZ * aspect
		local pad = 20
		local loX = minX - pad + halfX
		local hiX = maxX + pad - halfX
		if loX <= hiX then
			lookX = math.clamp(lookX, loX, hiX)
		else
			lookX = midX
		end
		local loZ = minY - pad + halfZ
		local hiZ = maxY + pad - halfZ
		if loZ <= hiZ then
			lookZ = math.clamp(lookZ, loZ, hiZ)
		else
			lookZ = midY
		end
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(lookX, h, lookZ), Vector3.new(lookX, 0, lookZ), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	end

	local function screenToMap(screen: Vector2): (number?, number?)
		local abs = viewport.AbsolutePosition
		local size = viewport.AbsoluteSize
		if size.X < 1 or size.Y < 1 then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local u = (screen.X - abs.X) / size.X
		local v = (screen.Y - abs.Y) / size.Y
		if u < 0 or v < 0 or u > 1 or v > 1 then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local h = cameraHeight()
		local aspect = size.X / size.Y
		local halfZ = h * math.tan(math.rad(FOV * 0.5))
		local halfX = halfZ * aspect
		local mx = lookX + (u - 0.5) * 2 * halfX
		local my = lookZ + (v - 0.5) * 2 * halfZ
		return mx, my
	end

	local function hitTerritory(mx: number, my: number): string?
		for _, t in mapDef.territories do
			if MapGeometry.PointInPolygon(mx, my, t.polygon) then
				return t.id
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function updateInfo()
		if not selectedId then
			infoBody.Text = "No territory selected.\nClick the map to inspect a province."
			return
		end
		local def = byId[selectedId]
		if not def then
			infoBody.Text = "Unknown territory."
			return
		end
		local ownerId = ownership[selectedId]
		if not ownerId or ownerId == "" then
			infoBody.Text = string.format(
				"%s\nID: %s\nOwner: Unclaimed\nRank: —\nStatus: —\nGreater realm: —",
				def.displayName,
				def.id
			)
			return
		end
		local owner = rulerOf(ownerId)
		local root = if owner then rulerOf(owner.rootRulerId) else nil
		infoBody.Text = string.format(
			"%s\nID: %s\nOwner: %s\nRank: %s\nStatus: %s\nGreater realm: %s",
			def.displayName,
			def.id,
			if owner then owner.displayName else ownerId,
			if owner then owner.titleName else "—",
			if owner then (if owner.independent then "Independent" else "Subject") else "—",
			if root then root.displayName else (if owner then owner.displayName else "—")
		)
	end

	local function colorize()
		for _, t in mapDef.territories do
			local ownerId = ownership[t.id]
			local fill = RealmColors.Unclaimed
			local rim = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 50)
			if ownerId and ownerId ~= "" then
				local owner = rulerOf(ownerId)
				local rootId = if owner and typeof(owner.rootRulerId) == "string" and owner.rootRulerId ~= "" then owner.rootRulerId else ownerId
				fill = ownerColor(rootId)
				rim = ownerColor(ownerId)
			end
			for _, p in fillParts[t.id] do
				p.Color = fill
				p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			end
			for _, p in rimParts[t.id] do
				p.Color = rim
			end
			local selected = selectedId == t.id
			for _, p in selectParts[t.id] do
				p.Color = SELECT_COLOR
				p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				p.Transparency = if selected then 0 else 1
			end
		end
		updateInfo()
		applyCamera()
		if selectedValue and selectedValue:IsA("StringValue") then
			selectedValue.Value = selectedId or ""
		end
	end

	local function applyTerritoryState(data: any)
		ownership = {}
		if typeof(data.territories) == "table" then
			for _, row in data.territories do
				if typeof(row.territoryId) == "string" then
					ownership[row.territoryId] = if row.hasOwner == true then (tostring(row.ownerRulerId)) else ""
				end
			end
		end
		colorIndex = {}
		if typeof(data.rulerColors) == "table" then
			for _, row in data.rulerColors do
				if typeof(row.rulerId) == "string" and typeof(row.colorIndex) == "number" then
					colorIndex[row.rulerId] = row.colorIndex
				end
			end
		end
		print("[Territory] State received map=", tostring(data.mapId))
		colorize()
	end

	local function applyHierarchyState(data: any)
		hierarchyById = {}
		if typeof(data.rulers) == "table" then
			for _, ruler in data.rulers do
				if typeof(ruler.rulerId) == "string" then
					hierarchyById[ruler.rulerId] = ruler
				end
			end
		end
		colorize()
	end

	territoryPush.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: any, payload: any)
		if kind == "State" then
			local data = decodeState(payload)
			if data then
				applyTerritoryState(data)
			else
				warn("[Territory] State decode failed")
			end
		end
	end)

	hierarchyPush.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: any, payload: any)
		if kind == "State" then
			local data = decodeState(payload)
			if data then
				applyHierarchyState(data)
			end
		end
	end)

	local function pointerScreen(): Vector2
		return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	end

	local function mouseOverMap(screen: Vector2): boolean
		local abs = mapStage.AbsolutePosition
		local size = mapStage.AbsoluteSize
		return screen.X >= abs.X and screen.Y >= abs.Y and screen.X <= abs.X + size.X and screen.Y <= abs.Y + size.Y
	end

	-- Map is the lowest input layer. Higher project GUI at this point owns the pointer.
	-- ResultToast is informational and is not treated as a blocking layer.
	-- AdminInspectPanel, EconomyPanel, MilitaryPanel, CommunicationsPanel, and visible Kohl command/dashboard chrome block the map.
	local function isKohlBlockingGui(obj: GuiObject): boolean
		local screenGui = obj:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
		if not screenGui then
			return false
		end
		local guiName = screenGui.Name
		if
			guiName ~= "FluxUILayerTopbar"
			and guiName ~= "FluxUILayerTop"
			and guiName ~= "FluxUILayerDefault"
			and guiName ~= "FluxUILayerBottom"
		then
			return false
		end
		local current: Instance? = obj
		while current and current ~= screenGui do
			if current:IsA("GuiObject") and current.Visible then
				local n = current.Name
				if n == "CommandBar" or n == "Window" or n == "Dialog" or n == "Cmdbar2" or n == "KADashboardButton" or n == "KACommandsButton" then
					return true
				end
			end
			current = current.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local function isMapDescendant(obj: Instance): boolean
		local current: Instance? = obj
		while current and current ~= gui do
			if current == mapStage then
				return true
			end
			current = current.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function blockingPanelOf(obj: Instance): GuiObject?
		local current: Instance? = obj
		while current and current ~= gui do
			if current:IsA("GuiObject") and current.Parent == gui then
				local name = current.Name
				if name == "VassalageOfferOverlay" or name == "DiplomacyOfferOverlay" or name == "TitlePanel" or name == "Main" or name == "TerritoryInfo" or name == "DiplomacyPanel" or name == "AdminInspectPanel" or name == "EconomyPanel" or name == "MilitaryPanel" or name == "CommunicationsPanel" then
					return current
				end
			end
			current = current.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function pointerOnHigherGui(screen: Vector2): boolean
		local objects = player.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(screen.X, screen.Y)
		for _, obj in objects do
			if obj:IsA("GuiObject") and obj.Visible and not isMapDescendant(obj) then
				if isKohlBlockingGui(obj) then
					return true
				end
				local panel = blockingPanelOf(obj)
				if panel and panel.Visible then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local mapPress = false

	-- Press must start on the map surface (MapStage / MapView), not on higher panels.
	-- Drag uses inset-corrected cursor position so GuiObject vs UIS coordinates cannot cancel pan.
	local function beginMapPress(input: InputObject)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		if pointerOnHigherGui(pointerScreen()) then
			return
		end
		mapPress = true
		dragging = true
		dragMoved = false
		dragStart = pointerScreen()
		lookStart = Vector2.new(lookX, lookZ)
	end

	mapStage.InputBegan:Connect(beginMapPress)
	viewport.InputBegan:Connect(beginMapPress)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, _gameProcessed)
		if dragging and mapPress and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and dragStart then
			local now = pointerScreen()
			if (now - dragStart).Magnitude > 6 then
				dragMoved = true
			end
			if dragMoved then
				local size = viewport.AbsoluteSize
				if size.X < 1 or size.Y < 1 then
					return
				end
				local h = cameraHeight()
				local halfZ = h * math.tan(math.rad(FOV * 0.5))
				local halfX = halfZ * (size.X / size.Y)
				local dx = (now.X - dragStart.X) / size.X * 2 * halfX
				local dz = (now.Y - dragStart.Y) / size.Y * 2 * halfZ
				lookX = lookStart.X - dx
				lookZ = lookStart.Y - dz
				applyCamera()
			end
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
			-- Active MapStage marks wheel as gameProcessed. That is the map surface, not a higher panel.
			local pos = pointerScreen()
			if not mouseOverMap(pos) or pointerOnHigherGui(pos) then
				return
			end
			if input.Position.Z > 0 then
				zoom = math.clamp(zoom * 1.12, MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM)
			else
				zoom = math.clamp(zoom / 1.12, MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM)
			end
			applyCamera()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		local wasMapPress = mapPress
		local wasDrag = dragMoved
		mapPress = false
		dragging = false
		dragMoved = false
		if not wasMapPress or wasDrag then
			return
		end
		local pos = pointerScreen()
		if pointerOnHigherGui(pos) then
			return
		end
		local mx, my = screenToMap(pos)
		if not mx or not my then
			return
		end
		selectedId = hitTerritory(mx, my)
		colorize()
	end)

	mapStage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		applyCamera()
	end)

	applyCamera()
	territoryIntent:FireServer("Ready")
	print("[Territory] controller started; Ready sent")
	colorize()
end

return TerritoryMapController

local function ensureCorner(inst: GuiObject, radius: number)
	local corner = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = inst
	end
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
end

local function ensureStroke(inst: GuiObject, thickness: number, color: Color3)
	local stroke = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if not stroke then
		stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Parent = inst
	end
	stroke.Thickness = thickness
	stroke.Color = color
	stroke.Transparency = 0
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
end

local function ensurePad(inst: GuiObject, inset: number)
	local pad = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	if not pad then
		pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.Parent = inst
	end
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, inset)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, inset)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, inset)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, inset)
